articles.headline: Gates credits return of Stone, depth of bigs for Mizzou surge
articles.description: Dennis Gates says the return of guard Jayden Stone from injury and the development of the 8-seed Tigers' frontcourt has them ready for the SEC Tournament.

articles.headline: Villanova says Matt Hodge suffered season-ending ACL tear
articles.description: Villanova starting forward Matt Hodge has a torn ACL in his right knee and will miss the rest of the season.

articles.headline: Villanova starting forward Matt Hodge injured against St. John's
articles.description: Villanova starting forward Matt Hodge injured his right leg Saturday night against No. 15 St. John's at Madison Square Garden.

articles.headline: Clemson's Carter Welling done for season with torn ACL
articles.description: Clemson said forward Carter Welling tore the ACL in his right knee in its opening game of the ACC tournament Wednesday.

articles.headline: Highlight: 11-seed Sooners continue SEC run by eliminating 6-seed Aggies
articles.description: With Nijel Pack leading the way with 20 points before leaving the game late with an injury, Oklahoma ousts Texas A&M, xx-xx, for its second win in as many days.

articles.headline: Nate Ament recaps Tennessee's second-half comeback over Auburn
articles.description: After leading the Vols past Auburn with 27 points in the SEC Tournament, Ament describes his game-changing play in his first action back after returning from an ankle injury.

articles.headline: Texas Tech star Christian Anderson available for tournament
articles.description: Texas Tech star guard Christian Anderson will be available for the NCAA tournament after leaving the Red Raiders' Big 12 tournament loss because of an apparent groin injury.
